editorial.marketOverview: Reuters reports Nasdaq futures up 2.4%, Nikkei up 2.1% and Chinese equities up nearly 4% on support measures. This corroborates the overnight risk rebound, not a synchronized US cash reversal. Earlier oil reports and the latest repository 10Y reading near 4.91% continue to indicate valuation pressure.
editorial.whatChanged: The fresh Reuters search adds evidence of Chinese equity support and reconfirms the futures rebound. The repository premarket report refreshed at 02:28 ET remains at -49/100; Open Watch refreshed at 07:44 UTC with 181 events and unchanged leading catalysts. No material change to the three-session path is established.
editorial.marketInterpretation: The futures rebound is constructive but the dashboard still describes mixed semiconductor and breadth signals and negative mega-cap leadership. VXN 38.53 versus VIX 26.80 suggests technology risk remains elevated, although underlying timestamps are unknown. Prior Fed hike pricing and crude quotations are not fresh synchronized observations. The cash reaction to these catalysts is still unknown.
editorial.threeDayPath: Friday November 27: relief rally possible, with fade risk in the shortened session. Monday November 30: normal liquidity and the Sunday OPEC+ outcome test whether gains hold. Tuesday December 1: JOLTS may reprice rates; tentative semiconductor earnings could alter leadership if confirmed.
editorial.bullCase: Sustained QQQ gains accompanied by SOX outperformance, broad participation and falling volatility would support a durable reversal, especially if oil and yields ease. Overseas strength alone does not establish that outcome.
editorial.bearCase: A failed opening rebound, weak chip leadership and persistent oil or yield pressure would reinforce the bearish skew. Existing inflation and tariff risks remain relevant; no isolated causal response to the Nvidia credit watch has been established.
editorial.watchNext: Check cash SOX versus QQQ, Nasdaq advance-decline breadth, VXN/VIX and paired 2Y/10Y after reopening. Monitor the 13:00 ET Friday close, Sunday OPEC+ and Tuesday JOLTS. Earnings dates remain tentative.
